storyCards.headline: Boys 'Round Here: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Blake Shelton's "Boys 'Round Here" reached #12 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Boys 'Round Here" is a song written by Rhett Akins, Dallas Davidson, and Craig Wiseman and recorded by American country music artist Blake Shelton.

The song peaked at #12 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 21 weeks on the chart.

Boys 'Round Here was released in 2013.
